hard_case: A compile-fail UI test discriminates a value: the const fn result is evaluated at compile time and printed into the committed .stderr ('expected an array with a size of 6').

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: frame_len(2) gives 5, so the fail file compiles
not equivalent: frame_len(2) gives 8, stderr says size of 8 not 6

reasoning: fail_frame_len.rs uses `[u8; frame_len(2)]`; rustc evaluates the const fn and the committed .stderr pins the size, so one mutant makes the file compile (compile_fail fails) and the other changes the diagnostic text.
